To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
family conciliation is a cost-effective method for dealing with disputes between married or cohabiting couples about the division of property and the care of children.

(1) family conciliation is more cost effective in terms of time and cost savings than court action in the majority of cases; (2) the majority of conciliation cases are settled; (3) conciliated settlements are more likely to be adhered to and are more satisfactory than those reached in court action; (4) the majority of cases that do not settle in conciliation are referred back to court action; (5) conciliation does not appear to be biased towards either sex,
